screen.oritech_space_age.invalid_rocket: No valid rocket was found on the connected launch pads.
screen.oritech_space_age.warning.no_mass: The rocket has no measurable mass.
screen.oritech_space_age.warning.insuffi: Not enough thrust to lift off.
Not enough fuel to reach orbit.
screen.oritech_space_age.loading_flight_: Loading star system and flight plan...
screen.oritech_space_age.map_controls: Drag to pan · Wheel to zoom · Double-click an object or orbit to focus · Right-click an object to plan a surface destination
screen.oritech_space_age.map.fit_system_: Fit the complete star system in the map.
screen.oritech_space_age.map.fit_route_t: Fit the planned flight route in the map.
screen.oritech_space_age.terminal.no_act: No active engines in this stage
screen.oritech_space_age.action.add_abor: Attach an optional condition that ends only this action early.
screen.oritech_space_age.action.abort_to: This condition ends the action early. The mission continues with the next card.
screen.oritech_space_age.action.target_t: Select the celestial body or asteroid this branch will navigate toward.
screen.oritech_space_age.action.destinat: Select the target surface or orbit band. Orbit altitude is measured from the target's surface.
screen.oritech_space_age.action.arrival_: Set the branch's velocity relative to the target at arrival. Maximum skips the final braking requirement.
screen.oritech_space_age.action.cruise_t: Limit speed during the transfer. Lower limits can save fuel but increase travel time; Maximum applies no cap.
Move this branch to a selected surface or orbit using the configured cruise and arrival speeds.
Attach the selected asteroid to the configured anchor segment after a safe close approach.
Split a connected segment or asteroid from this branch and create its separate timeline.
Automatically detach an exhausted booster stage.

Hold the craft at its current location with occasional correction burns. A powered antenna craft in an assigned Earth low/high slot also serves as a constellation relay. Station keeping ends when either communication RF or propulsion runs out.
Stop tracking this branch and discard its craft from the plan.
screen.oritech_space_age.action.decouple: Disconnect %s ↔ %s · Current branch keeps %s · New branch gets %s
Select the segment side that stays on the current branch, then select a directly connected side for the new branch.
screen.oritech_space_age.action.arrival_: Choose the velocity constraint at arrival.
screen.oritech_space_age.action.landing_: Choose the intended absolute Overworld X/Z impact position. An offset is applied only when an Uncertainty abort condition is selected.
screen.oritech_space_age.action.completi: Choose when this navigation should end before reaching its destination. Hover each condition for its calculation basis.
screen.oritech_space_age.action.conditio: Triggers when the straight-line distance to the selected destination point is at or below this many meters.
Triggers when the transfer solver's predicted remaining flight time is at or below this many seconds.
Triggers when predicted Earth landing uncertainty, derived from remaining distance, is at or below this many blocks. This value also bounds the impact-position offset.
Stops maintaining position when remaining RF reaches this percentage of the craft's launch capacity.
Stops maintaining position when remaining fuel reaches this percentage of the craft's launch capacity.
screen.oritech_space_age.action.maintain: Optionally end station keeping before RF or fuel runs out. Thresholds use a percentage of launch capacity.
screen.oritech_space_age.released_astero: The released asteroid is not predicted to reach Earth.
screen.oritech_space_age.object.arrival_: At arrival (%s MC days) · saved at %s, %s
screen.oritech_space_age.name: Name:
message.oritech_space_age.rocket_invalid: The rocket is no longer valid.
notification.oritech_space_age.survey_re: %s new contacts · %s updated contacts are now available on Earth.
Instantly reveal every asteroid in the current survey region. The results stay onboard until transmitted or safely returned to Earth.
Legacy action retained for saved plans. New constellation craft relay automatically while maintaining position in an Earth low/high orbital slot.
Send onboard observations to Earth through powered antennas and active relays. Wait for a connection or continue when the configured timeout expires.
screen.oritech_space_age.action.duration: How long to run this action. One Minecraft day is 1,200 seconds.
screen.oritech_space_age.action.timeout_: Wait for an Earth link to deliver onboard discoveries. A timeout continues the plan without delivery. Wait until delivered has no time limit and can prevent a later landing. Safe landing delivers onboard data automatically.
screen.oritech_space_age.action.slot_too: Choose a position in this Earth orbit. Auto selects an unused slot. A powered antenna craft fills its low/high constellation slot while executing Maintain Position. Complete rings need 6 low or 36 high-orbit positions.
screen.oritech_space_age.blocked.no_scan: Navigate to a survey region before scanning.
screen.oritech_space_age.blocked.scan_ou: The current target or survey region is beyond the 250,000 m scanner range.
screen.oritech_space_age.blocked.no_scan: No scanner remains on this branch. Keep a scanner attached through staging and separation.
screen.oritech_space_age.blocked.no_ante: No antenna remains on this branch. Keep an antenna attached through staging and separation.
screen.oritech_space_age.blocked.not_eno: The module-bearing segments do not have enough RF for this action. RF on detached or other segments cannot power these modules.
screen.oritech_space_age.blocked.precise: An asteroid surface approach needs a precise position. Approach its tight orbit and scan before touching or anchoring it.
screen.oritech_space_age.blocked.plan_bl: This action cannot run with the current target and attached segments. Check its target, anchor, and coupling selections.
screen.oritech_space_age.blocked.not_eno: The remaining propulsion budget cannot complete this transfer. Add fuel/RF or reduce the cruise speed.
screen.oritech_space_age.blocked.no_acti: No fueled engine is active on the remaining craft. Check stage assignments, booster separations, chemical fuel, and local ion-engine RF.
screen.oritech_space_age.blocked.no_feas: No transfer meets the requested speed, gravity and arrival conditions. Try reducing arrival speed or adding fuel or thrust.
screen.oritech_space_age.blocked.integra: The transfer exceeded the calculation step limit. Try a shorter route or a different arrival speed.
This transfer exceeds the forecast time limit. Increase the cruise speed or choose a closer destination.
screen.oritech_space_age.blocked.destroy: This arrival destroys the craft. Reduce the arrival speed; surface arrivals can cause an impact.
screen.oritech_space_age.blocked.target_: Choose an available target. This target is missing from the received survey data.
screen.oritech_space_age.blocked.empty_c: No segments remain on this branch after separation.
screen.oritech_space_age.blocked.asteroi: Release the currently attached asteroid before connecting another one.
screen.oritech_space_age.blocked.unsafe_: Navigate to this asteroid surface or tight orbit at 12 m/s or less before connecting it.
screen.oritech_space_age.blocked.no_aste: Choose an asteroid-anchor segment that remains attached to this branch.
screen.oritech_space_age.blocked.no_coup: The selected segments are no longer coupled on this branch. Choose a connection that remains attached, or the anchor holding the asteroid.
screen.oritech_space_age.scan.energy_ava: Local RF at action start: %s RF
screen.oritech_space_age.scan.energy_hel: The scan is instant and has a fixed cost. Available RF counts scanner-bearing segments attached at this point in the mission.
